name: @scion-scxml/debug

scripts.fix-global: sed -i -e 's/g.scxml = f()/g.scion = g.scion || {}; g.scion.scxml = f(); g.scion.core = g.scion.scxml.core;/' dist/scxml.debug.js
scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && browserify -d index.js -o dist/scxml.debug.js -s scxml -v && npm run fix-global

author: Jacob Beard <jake@jacobeanrnd.com>
description: Drop-in replacement for the SCION scxml compiler module, that automatically enables the sourcemap-plugin and monitor client
